name: ai-test-generator
description: Turns user stories into structured, executable test cases using AI.

scripts.codegen: node src/cli.js codegen --plan examples/saucedemo-testplan.json --name saucedemo && node src/cli.js codegen --plan examples/fixture-api-testplan.json --name jsonplaceholder
scripts.check: for f in $(find src -name '*.js'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --check playwright.config.js
scripts.report: npm run codegen && playwright test --reporter=json > .playwright-results.json && node src/cli.js report --plan examples/fixture-api-testplan.json --results .playwright-results.json --out docs/example-coverage-report.md
